programme.title: Samudra Cinta
programme.desc: The story begins in a simple house, Rusdi with his wife Novi and their three children: Andra, Novan and Vina are chatting in the living room while watching television. Because Vina couldn't sleep, Novi asked Rusdi to turn off the TV. It was then, they just heard the sound of a baby crying that seemed to come from the front of the house. Curious Rusdi and Novi finally put Vina in the baby box and stepped outside to check on the baby. Novi and Rusdi checked to the front and were very surprised to find Lila holding a baby. Lila begs Rusdi to take care of her flesh and blood, which is named Cinta.

programme.title: Putri Pewaris
programme.desc: Aina, a college student and promotional model, accidentally gets into a conflict with Darel after posting a video of his actions that goes viral on social media. Unbeknownst to them, Darel is the son of Ferdi, the man who took over Aina’s father’s company and killed him 20 years ago. Their feud becomes even more complicated when an incident nearly forces them to marry, causing their hatred to slowly turn into love. But will their love survive when the dark secrets of both families begin to surface?

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Maya is trapped in a fake marriage with Andrian, the heir to a business empire who gradually falls in love with her. However, Hana’s revenge leads Maya to fall into an abyss and she is presumed dead. When Maya is revealed to be alive and in Roni’s hands, a conspiracy makes her believe that Andrian has betrayed her.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: A single act of betrayal changes Asti's life forever. Stripped of her face, her family, and the life she once believed in, she rises with a new identity to uncover the conspiracy that destroyed everything she held dear. As each hidden truth comes to light, Asti must choose between seeking revenge and fighting for the future of her child—the only reason she continues to live.

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Since childhood, Arina has lived under the shadow of a dark and painful past. Trapped in a family consumed by vengeance, secrets, and hatred, Arina must uncover the truth before it's too late.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS IS A POPULAR INDONESIAN CHILDREN'S ANIMATION WITH CHEERFUL AND UPbeat SONGS. THEY WERE CREATED AS A FORM OF INNOVATION IN THE CHILDREN'S MUSIC INDUSTRY IN INDONESIA. PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU AND ADUL IS A 3D ANIMATED FILM SERIAL ABOUT THE ADVENTURES OF CHILDREN IN THE MULTICULTURAL SUBURBS OF JAKARTA. THEIR INQUIRIES MAKE THEM WANTED TO EXPLORE, SOMETIMES CAUSING A FUCKING FUCK.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: Just For Laughs
programme.desc: Just For Laughs

programme.title: POCOYO
programme.desc: POCOYO IS AN ANIMATED SERIES THAT FOLLOWS THE ADVENTURES OF AN ENERGY AND CURIOUS LITTLE BOY NAMED POCOYO. WITH HIS FRIENDS, PATO (DUCK), ELLY (ELEPHANT), LOULA (DOG), AND SLEEPY BIRD (BIRD), POCOYO EXPLORE HIS COLORFUL WORLD WITH BOUNDLESS JOY AND CURIOSITY. EACH EPISODE FEATURES A NEW ADVENTURE WHERE POCOYO LEARNS ABOUT FRIENDSHIP, HONESTY, AND OVERCOMES CHALLENGES WITH HIS IMAGINATION AND INTELLIGENCE. With the help of his friends and guidance from PANDAI (the unseen voice actor), Pocoyo encounters hilarious and engaging situations that bring positive and educational messages to young viewers. With its bright and cheerful animation style, "Pocoyo" is a series that entertains while teaching children important values ​​about cooperation, kindness, and exploring the world around them.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Little Angel is an animated musical show for pre-schoolers. The show has been captivating families around the world with its cheeky humor and catchy upbeat songs.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS
programme.desc: Each episode features a new story that is both entertaining and educational, with interactive moments that invite children to guess, sing, and share in the joy with the characters.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION
programme.desc: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION TELLS THE ADVENTURES OF FIVE SPECIAL TEENS—NAURA, RAHSYA, ADARA, GIBRAN, AND IRSHAD—WHICH ARE FOUND AND CARED FOR BY FATHIR. THESE FIVE CHILDREN HAVE UNIQUE AND DIFFERENT SUPERPOWERS. THEY USE THESE POWERS TO SOLVE VARIOUS CASES AND PROBLEMS THAT OCCUR AROUND THEM. IN ADDITION TO RESCUE MISSIONS, THEY ALSO HAVE TO FACE DAILY CONFLICTS AT SCHOOL, ESPECIALLY FROM THEIR ENEMY GANG, THE BEAST. THIS ANIMATION FOCUS ON THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP, COHESION, AND THE USE OF SUPERPOWERS FOR GOOD.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY STARTED A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! FROM BUILDING BU INAH'S DREAM STORE, THE EXCITEMENT OF BEING NEIGHBORS WITH CEU KOKOM, TO PAK SOMAT'S STRUGGLE TO BECOME AN ONLINE MOTORCYCLE TAXI FOR THE SAKE OF HIS FAMILY. A WARM STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND A MORAL MESSAGE SUITABLE FOR ALL AGES.

programme.title: KARTUN FAVORIT KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an engaging show about four young pheasant chicks who grow up in a natural forest under the gentle care and loving guidance of Mother Flora. She always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need her. When the chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (NIU NAITANG SI NO 23)
programme.desc: SUNNY GIRL NO.23 IS NOT ONLY ABOUT THE GROWTH JOURNEY OF A CHEESY GIRL, BUT ALSO THE FIRST REALISTIC THEMED ANIMATED SERIES THAT REFLECTS PARENT-CHILD EDUCATION AND SCHOOL LIFE IN CHINA. THE MAIN CHARACTER IS AN 8-YEAR-OLD PRIMARY SCHOOL STUDENT. SHE IS NOT EXTRAORDINARY. SHE IS A GIRL WITH A CARELESS CHARACTER BUT SHE IS AN ENERGETIC, OPTIMISTIC AND KIND GIRL WHO IS TALENTED IN DRAWING WITH CREATIVENESS AND HAS THE ABILITY TO SOLVE PROBLEMS, WHICH MOST CHILDREN CAN FIND. THIS ANIMATION IS LOVED BY AUDIENCES IN MAINLAND CHINA, AND HAS BEEN DISTRIBUTED TO SOUTHEAST ASIA INCLUDING MALAYSIA AND VIETNAM. THE FIRST SEASON EXPRESSED A WORLDVIEW WITH 26 FUNNY STORIES, NAMELY "THERE ARE SO MANY DIFFERENT FORMS OF EXCELLENCE, EVERY CHILD IS EXCELLENT IN THEIR OWN STRENGTHS," PRESENTING NOT ONLY THE CHILDHOOD OF CONTEMPORARY ELEMENTARY SCHOOL STUDENTS, BUT ALSO THE Clash BETWEEN OLD AND NEW PARENTING CONCEPTS. THE SECOND SEASON CARRIES AND ENHANCES THIS WORLDVIEW.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 26: HORIZONS
programme.desc: Pokémon season 26 horizons follows the new adventures of Ash Ketchum and his friends as they explore new territories they have never explored before. After successfully conquering the Pokémon League in the previous region, Ash decides to seek new challenges and expand the horizons of his adventures. In this new region, Ash meets new Pokémon trainers, including characters eager to test the strength of their teams. While facing various challenges, Ash and his friends also learn about new Pokémon they have never encountered before, as well as the new culture and way of life in the region. However, their adventure is not easy. They must face new threats, including an evil organization that seeks to exploit the power of Pokémon for their own purposes.

programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS IS A POPULAR INDONESIAN CHILDREN'S ANIMATION WITH CHEERFUL AND UPbeat SONGS. THEY WERE CREATED AS A FORM OF INNOVATION IN THE CHILDREN'S MUSIC INDUSTRY IN INDONESIA. PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU AND ADUL IS A 3D ANIMATED FILM SERIAL ABOUT THE ADVENTURES OF CHILDREN IN THE MULTICULTURAL SUBURBS OF JAKARTA. THEIR INQUIRIES MAKE THEM WANTED TO EXPLORE, SOMETIMES CAUSING A FUCKING FUCK.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: Just For Laughs
programme.desc: Just For Laughs

programme.title: POCOYO
programme.desc: POCOYO IS AN ANIMATED SERIES THAT FOLLOWS THE ADVENTURES OF AN ENERGY AND CURIOUS LITTLE BOY NAMED POCOYO. WITH HIS FRIENDS, PATO (DUCK), ELLY (ELEPHANT), LOULA (DOG), AND SLEEPY BIRD (BIRD), POCOYO EXPLORE HIS COLORFUL WORLD WITH BOUNDLESS JOY AND CURIOSITY. EACH EPISODE FEATURES A NEW ADVENTURE WHERE POCOYO LEARNS ABOUT FRIENDSHIP, HONESTY, AND OVERCOMES CHALLENGES WITH HIS IMAGINATION AND INTELLIGENCE. With the help of his friends and guidance from PANDAI (the unseen voice actor), Pocoyo encounters hilarious and engaging situations that bring positive and educational messages to young viewers. With its bright and cheerful animation style, "Pocoyo" is a series that entertains while teaching children important values ​​about cooperation, kindness, and exploring the world around them.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Little Angel is an animated musical show for pre-schoolers. The show has been captivating families around the world with its cheeky humor and catchy upbeat songs.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS
programme.desc: Each episode features a new story that is both entertaining and educational, with interactive moments that invite children to guess, sing, and share in the joy with the characters.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION
programme.desc: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION TELLS THE ADVENTURES OF FIVE SPECIAL TEENS—NAURA, RAHSYA, ADARA, GIBRAN, AND IRSHAD—WHICH ARE FOUND AND CARED FOR BY FATHIR. THESE FIVE CHILDREN HAVE UNIQUE AND DIFFERENT SUPERPOWERS. THEY USE THESE POWERS TO SOLVE VARIOUS CASES AND PROBLEMS THAT OCCUR AROUND THEM. IN ADDITION TO RESCUE MISSIONS, THEY ALSO HAVE TO FACE DAILY CONFLICTS AT SCHOOL, ESPECIALLY FROM THEIR ENEMY GANG, THE BEAST. THIS ANIMATION FOCUS ON THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP, COHESION, AND THE USE OF SUPERPOWERS FOR GOOD.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY STARTED A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! FROM BUILDING BU INAH'S DREAM STORE, THE EXCITEMENT OF BEING NEIGHBORS WITH CEU KOKOM, TO PAK SOMAT'S STRUGGLE TO BECOME AN ONLINE MOTORCYCLE TAXI FOR THE SAKE OF HIS FAMILY. A WARM STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND A MORAL MESSAGE SUITABLE FOR ALL AGES.

programme.title: KARTUN FAVORIT KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an engaging show about four young pheasant chicks who grow up in a natural forest under the gentle care and loving guidance of Mother Flora. She always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need her. When the chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (HAKKA KECIL DAN SAHABAT AJAIB)
programme.desc: Little Hakka tells the story of children and nature. Ah Liang and Amei, two Hakka sisters living in the city of Chizhu, Lingnan, find an injured crane on the slope of Uncle Man's bee garden and decide to save it. During the thrilling rescue, the children accidentally discover the thousand-year-old secret of the Hakka ancestors and the forest animals.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 26: HORIZONS
programme.desc: Pokémon season 26 horizons follows the new adventures of Ash Ketchum and his friends as they explore new territories they have never explored before. After successfully conquering the Pokémon League in the previous region, Ash decides to seek new challenges and expand the horizons of his adventures. In this new region, Ash meets new Pokémon trainers, including characters eager to test the strength of their teams. While facing various challenges, Ash and his friends also learn about new Pokémon they have never encountered before, as well as the new culture and way of life in the region. However, their adventure is not easy. They must face new threats, including an evil organization that seeks to exploit the power of Pokémon for their own purposes.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT

programme.title: Holy Ghost People

programme.title: Radioflash

programme.title: The Room

programme.title: Burial Ground Massacre

programme.title: Clean

programme.title: The School

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: A British nurse escapes an attack on her outpost. Hunted by a German-led war party, and with help from local warriors, she embarks on an epic journey to save a neighboring outpost.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Cop Jack Stone robs a Russian mob bank to end in the same prison as the mob boss killing Jack's wife. An inmate helps him as does a reporter. Lots of fights.

programme.title: Jin & Jun
programme.desc: After getting roughed up by bullies, a high school student in despair encounters a genie who can turn around his luck - and his fortunes.

programme.title: Kalung Jelangkung
programme.desc: When Kiki and her friends are on a holiday in the village, they play the jelangkung inside an old building. Later, Kiki finds a necklace in a cemetery, and wears it. She falls ill, and deliriously mentions a name.

programme.title: Titisan Si Pitung
programme.desc: Tells the story of a young man who tries hard to quell injustice in his village caused by Darip and Ramdani. He goes to study outside the village to be able to overcome those people.

programme.title: Akal-Akalan
programme.desc: Because the persistent of Kadir and Doyok to date two daughters of Harja appear to be serious, the father eventually agrees to allow them to prove that they are financially independent enough.

programme.title: Jangan Bilang Siapa-Siapa
